parts.name: Flat roof
parts.info: The flat roof of a school, union office or shop with internet.

parts.name: Galvanised mast with guy wires
parts.info: A 3 m galvanised pipe on a bolted base plate, held by three guy wires.

part.name: Galvanised mast 3 m, base plate, guy wires and clamps

parts.name: Outdoor antenna, 868/915 MHz
parts.info: A fibreglass antenna at the top, about 3.5 m above the roof. Height matters more than power for range.

part.name: Outdoor 868/915 MHz fibreglass antenna (about 3-5 dBi) with 3 m low-loss cable

parts.name: Antenna cable
parts.info: 3 m of low-loss cable down the mast to the box.

part.name: Outdoor 868/915 MHz fibreglass antenna (about 3-5 dBi) with 3 m low-loss cable

parts.name: Gateway box
parts.info: IP65 box on the parapet wall, with glands for the antenna and power cables.

part.name: IP65 enclosure, about 160 x 120 x 80 mm, with cable glands

parts.name: Lid with status light
parts.info: The green light blinks with every packet received.

part.name: IP65 enclosure, about 160 x 120 x 80 mm, with cable glands

parts.name: RFM95W LoRa radio
parts.info: The same radio as on every stake. It listens all the time, at about 30 mA.

parts.name: FireBeetle 2 ESP32-E controller
parts.info: Checks each packet's signature, stores and forwards it.

parts.name: microSD card breakout
parts.info: Keeps every packet until the server confirms it.

parts.name: Power manager and backup cell
parts.info: Mains via a USB charger; the 18650 keeps it listening for about 13 hours in a power cut.

parts.name: USB charger lead
parts.info: From a socket inside the building.

part.name: 5 V 2 A USB charger and cable
